description: Opus CC unit B18: Sleep Talk calling Sparkling Aria (its onAfterMove, formerly refused for a called move). The sleeping Primarina (3 turns left) has only Sparkling Aria to call; Garchomp and Clefable protect, so the burned ally Hitmontop is the one hit target: the secondary gives it the sparklingaria volatile and runMove's AfterMove, which sees the called move (`if (this.battle.activeMove) move = this.battle.activeMove`), removes it and cures the burn. The protected, burned Garchomp keeps its burn.
